prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished wide 2D side-view battle background for a mobile storybook fantasy RPG. Primary request: a beautifully illustrated ruined woodland courtyard for two squads facing each other, flat side-view presentation like a hand-painted fantasy JRPG battle stage. Scene: broken ancient archways at the far left and far right, a distant crumbling castle seen through tall enchanted trees, misty indigo forest depth, a few tiny warm golden motes. Composition: wide 16:9 landscape. Low orthographic side camera, NOT a top-down or isometric arena. The playable ground is a broad unobstructed nearly horizontal mossy cobblestone platform in the lower third. Its flat walking surface stretches from left edge to right edge. Leave the full center and both lower sides open for characters standing and dashing. Layered foliage silhouettes in the very bottom foreground frame the scene lightly, without occluding characters. Style: richly hand-painted 2D storybook environment, angular expressive shapes, visible brush texture, delicate engraved stone detail, harmonious indigo and jade foliage, muted burgundy accents, warm amber rays through trees. Luminous yet moody fairy-tale atmosphere, suitable behind cel-shaded outlined characters. Middle battle zone must have restrained detail and contrast for readable sprites. Constraints: NO characters, monsters, people, creatures, text, letters, interface, icons, grids, selection circles, UI panels or logos. No perspective lines radiating toward camera, no photorealistic 3D.
